'''Logistics officer''' was a position in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Nemet/Legends|Nemet]] served as the logistics [[Officer/Legends|officer]] aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']].

It was also a staff position in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], with a logistics officer typically being attached to [[Battalion headquarters|battalion]] and [[regimental headquarters]].
